novel_features.name: Company pulse
novel_features.description: Summarize complaint volume, products, issues, responses, timeliness, narrative availability, and a prior-window delta for one company.

novel_features.name: Cohort-safe peer comparison
novel_features.description: Compare companies inside one explicit cohort while labeling counts as non-market-adjusted complaint volume.

novel_features.name: Emerging-theme delta
novel_features.description: Rank mechanical product and issue count changes between current and baseline windows without semantic or causal claims.

novel_features.name: Narrative evidence packet
novel_features.description: Select a newest-first bounded packet of published narratives with complaint IDs, exact cohort dates, and availability caveats.

novel_features.name: Change watch
novel_features.description: Compare the latest bounded cohort with a locally persisted prior observation and report newly observed complaint IDs and categories.

narrative.value_prop: Build reproducible complaint cohorts, company pulses, peer comparisons, emerging-theme tables, and narrative evidence packets without presenting raw complaint counts as quality scores.

quickstart.comment: Inspect a bounded published complaint cohort.

quickstart.command: cfpb-complaints-pp-cli company pulse --company 'CAPITAL ONE FINANCIAL CORPORATION' --window 30d --agent
quickstart.comment: Summarize one company's recent complaint mix.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for reproducible research over published CFPB complaint metadata and selected narratives.
anti_triggers: Do not treat complaint counts as market-adjusted rates or company quality rankings.
Do not use this CLI to file or resolve a complaint.

recipes.title: Compare peers in one cohort
recipes.command: cfpb-complaints-pp-cli compare companies 'CAPITAL ONE FINANCIAL CORPORATION' 'DISCOVER BANK' --product 'Credit card' --window 90d --agent
recipes.explanation: Use identical filters and keep raw-volume caveats attached.

recipes.title: Collect traceable narratives
recipes.command: cfpb-complaints-pp-cli narratives packet --company 'CAPITAL ONE FINANCIAL CORPORATION' --limit 10 --agent
recipes.explanation: Return complaint IDs with published narrative evidence.
